notes.title: Update #2 - Full Featured (Day Only)
notes.notes:
For one day (the last day of the playtest), we're making the full featured version available.

What's been added:

- Singleplayer AFK mode
- Bait system
- More background unlocks
- More fish and objects
- Menu system added to multiplayer
- Multiplayer exit bug fixed
- 4 new music tracks

notes.title: Playtest Update #1
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce the first (and possibly only) update to the "Strange Shores" playtest.

By adding the following features, we feel the playtest better represents the final product.

Here's what we've done:


 Added background music
 Added sound effects
 Added audio controls
 Updated credits to include music composer
 Added localisation for Traditional Chinese and Japanese
 Added animation to catch text
 Fixed scaling bug present on multiplayer
